title: Left/Right always switches tabs even while a custom-model or notify text input …
description:
Left/Right always switches tabs even while a custom-model or notify text input is focused (per AC5 and covered by a test), so arrow keys cannot move the text cursor within those fields. This is intended by the spec; consider suppressing TabBar navigation while a TextInput is active in a future iteration for smoother editing.
